requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Configurator enforces mutually exclusive use of a half-base cut face vs a three-base junction corner. Current build is half-e at 0,0,0 with two full neighbours; offers drawer=0, spike=1. Previous attempt half-s with neighbours gave drawer and spike each 1 offer at junction [-1,0/-1,1/0,0] but apply together returned SPIKE_CLASH 'No other junction is open for this spike' – adding that spike closes the junction. No placement allows both parts to occupy the same corner touching. Build has 3 bases, 0 drawers, 0 spikes.

finish.summary: Build is 3 bases (half-e + 2 full) with no drawer/no spike. Requirement for drawer and spike at the very same corner of the same cell touching is unmet: configurator rules make this geometry impossible – a half-base straight cut face (drawer) and a three-bases-meet point (spike) cannot coincide, and when both offered at adjacent junction [-1,0/-1,1/0,0] the spike apply is refused with SPIKE_CLASH closing the junction. No touching co-location offer exists.
